surface.help: Mypy is a program that will type check your Python code.

verbs.help: Mypy is a program that will type check your Python code.

allow_redefinition.help: Allow flexible variable redefinition with a new type (inverse: --disallow-redefinition)

allow_redefinition_old.help: Allow restricted, unconditional variable redefinition with a new type (inverse: --disallow-redefinition-old)

allow_untyped_globals.help: Suppress toplevel errors caused by missing annotations (inverse: --disallow-untyped-globals)

always_false.help: Additional variable to be considered False (may be repeated)

always_true.help: Additional variable to be considered True (may be repeated)

cache_dir.help: Store module cache info in the given folder in incremental mode (defaults to '.mypy_cache')

cache_fine_grained.help: Include fine-grained dependency information in the cache for the mypy daemon

check_untyped_defs.help: Type check the interior of functions without type annotations (inverse: --no-check-untyped-defs)

command.help: Type-check program passed in as string

config_file.help: Configuration file, must have a [mypy] section (defaults to mypy.ini, .mypy.ini, pyproject.toml, setup.cfg)

custom_typeshed_dir.help: Use the custom typeshed in DIR

deprecated_calls_exclude.help: Disable deprecated warnings for functions/methods coming from specific package, module, or class

disallow_any_decorated.help: Disallow functions that have Any in their signature after decorator transformation

disallow_any_explicit.help: Disallow explicit Any in type positions

disallow_any_expr.help: Disallow all expressions that have type Any

disallow_any_generics.help: Disallow usage of generic types that do not specify explicit type parameters (inverse: --allow-any-generics)

disallow_any_unimported.help: Disallow Any types resulting from unfollowed imports (inverse: --allow-any-unimported)

disallow_incomplete_defs.help: Disallow defining functions with incomplete type annotations (while still allowing entirely unannotated definitions) (inverse: --allow-incomplete-defs)

disallow_subclassing_any.help: Disallow subclassing values of type 'Any' when defining classes (inverse: --allow-subclassing-any)

disallow_untyped_calls.help: Disallow calling functions without type annotations from functions with type annotations (inverse: --allow-untyped-calls)

disallow_untyped_decorators.help: Disallow decorating typed functions with untyped decorators (inverse: --allow-untyped-decorators)

disallow_untyped_defs.help: Disallow defining functions without type annotations or with incomplete type annotations (inverse: --allow-untyped-defs)

enable_incomplete_feature.help: Enable support of incomplete/experimental features for early preview

exclude.help: Regular expression to match file names, directory names or paths which mypy should ignore while recursively discovering files to check, e.g. --exclude '/setup\.py$'

exclude_gitignore.help: Use .gitignore file(s) to exclude files from checking (in addition to any explicit --exclude if present) (inverse: --no-exclude-gitignore)

explicit_package_bases.help: Use current directory and MYPYPATH to determine module names of files passed (inverse: --no-explicit-package-bases)

extra_checks.help: Enable additional checks that are technically correct but may be impractical in real code

find_occurrences.help: Print out all usages of a class member (experimental)

follow_untyped_imports.help: Typecheck modules without stubs or py.typed marker

hide_error_codes.help: Hide error codes in error messages (inverse: --show-error-codes)

ignore_missing_imports.help: Silently ignore imports of missing modules

implicit_optional.help: Assume arguments with default values of None are Optional (inverse: --no-implicit-optional)

install_types.help: Install detected missing library stub packages using pip (inverse: --no-install-types)

junit_xml.help: Write a JUnit XML test result document with type checking results to the given file

module.help: Type-check module; can repeat for more modules

native_parser.help: Enable faster parser that parses directly to mypy AST (inverse: --no-native-parser)

no_error_summary.help: Do not show error stats summary (inverse: --error-summary)

no_fixed_format_cache.help: Do not use new fixed format cache (inverse: --fixed-format-cache)

no_implicit_reexport.help: Treat imports as private unless aliased (inverse: --implicit-reexport)

no_silence_site_packages.help: Do not silence errors in PEP 561 compliant installed packages

no_site_packages.help: Do not search for installed PEP 561 compliant packages

no_strict_bytes.help: Treat bytearray and memoryview as subtypes of bytes (inverse: --strict-bytes)

no_warn_no_return.help: Do not warn about functions that end without returning (inverse: --warn-no-return)

non_interactive.help: Install stubs without asking for confirmation and hide errors, with --install-types (inverse: --interactive)

num_workers.help: Number of separate mypy worker processes (experimental)

package.help: Type-check package recursively; can be repeated

platform.help: Type check special-cased code for the given OS platform (defaults to sys.platform)

pretty.help: Use visually nicer output in error messages: Use soft word wrap, show source code snippets, and show error location markers (inverse: --no-pretty)

python_executable.help: Python executable used for finding PEP 561 compliant installed packages and stubs

python_version.help: Type check code assuming it will be running on Python x.y

report_deprecated_as_note.help: Report importing or using deprecated features as notes instead of errors (inverse: --no-report-deprecated-as-note)

scripts_are_modules.help: Script x becomes module x instead of __main__

shadow_file.help: When encountering SOURCE_FILE, read and type check the contents of SHADOW_FILE instead

show_column_numbers.help: Show column numbers in error messages (inverse: --hide-column-numbers)

show_error_code_links.help: Show links to error code documentation (inverse: --hide-error-code-links)

show_error_context.help: Precede errors with "note:" messages explaining context (inverse: --hide-error-context)

show_error_end.help: Show end line/end column numbers in error messages

skip_cache_mtime_checks.help: Skip cache internal consistency checks based on mtime

skip_version_check.help: Allow using cache written by older mypy version

sqlite_cache.help: Use a sqlite database to store the cache (inverse: --no-sqlite-cache)

strict.help: Strict mode; enables the following flags: --disallow-any-generics, --disallow-subclassing-any, --disallow-untyped-calls, --disallow-untyped-defs, --disallow-incomplete- defs, --check-untyped-defs, --disallow-untyped-decorators, --warn-redundant-casts, --warn-unused-ignores, --warn-return-any, --no-implicit-reexport, --strict-equality, --extra-checks

strict_equality.help: Prohibit equality, identity, and container checks for non-overlapping types (except `None`) (inverse: --no-strict-equality)

untyped_calls_exclude.help: Disable --disallow-untyped-calls for functions/methods coming from specific package, module, or class

warn_incomplete_stub.help: Warn if missing type annotation in typeshed, only relevant with --disallow-untyped-defs or --disallow-incomplete-defs enabled (inverse: --no-warn-incomplete-stub)

warn_redundant_casts.help: Warn about casting an expression to its inferred type (inverse: --no-warn-redundant-casts)

warn_return_any.help: Warn about returning values of type Any from non-Any typed functions (inverse: --no-warn-return-any)

warn_unreachable.help: Warn about statements or expressions inferred to be unreachable (inverse: --no-warn-unreachable)

warn_unused_configs.help: Warn about unused '[mypy-<pattern>]' or '[[tool.mypy.overrides]]' config sections (inverse: --no-warn-unused-configs)

warn_unused_ignores.help: Warn about unneeded '# type: ignore' comments (inverse: --no-warn-unused-ignores)

\tstrict_bytes.help: Disable treating bytearray and memoryview as subtypes of bytes (inverse: --no-strict-bytes)

\tallow_redefinition.help: Alias to --allow-redefinition-old; will point to --allow-redefinition-new in v2.0 (inverse: --disallow-redefinition)

\tallow_redefinition_new.help: Allow more flexible variable redefinition semantics (inverse: --disallow-redefinition-new)

\tstrict.help: Strict mode; enables the following flags: --disallow-any-generics, --disallow-subclassing-any, --disallow-untyped-calls, --disallow-untyped-defs, --disallow-incomplete- defs, --check-untyped-defs, --disallow-untyped-decorators, --warn-redundant-casts, --warn-unused-ignores, --warn-return-any, --no-implicit-reexport, --strict-equality, --strict-bytes, --extra-checks

Strict mode; enables the following flags: --warn-unused-configs, --disallow-any-generics, --disallow-subclassing-any, --disallow-untyped-calls, --disallow-untyped-defs, --disallow-incomplete-defs, --check-untyped-defs, --disallow-untyped-decorators, --warn-redundant-casts, --warn-unused-ignores, --warn-return-any, --no-implicit-reexport, --strict-equality, --strict-bytes, --extra-checks

\tfixed_format_cache.help: Use new fast and compact fixed format cache

\tallow_redefinition.help: Allow restricted, unconditional variable redefinition with a new type (inverse: --disallow-redefinition)

\tallow_redefinition_new.help: Allow more flexible variable redefinition semantics (experimental) (inverse: --disallow-redefinition-new)

\tfixed_format_cache.help: Use experimental fast and compact fixed format cache

\tjunit_xml.help: Write junit.xml to the given file
